title: A Mixed-Methods Evaluation of LLM-Based Chatbots for Menopause

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic substitution in prompts by appending text specifying the patient's race ('Black' or 'White') to examine potential differences in response objectivity and service options.
